body:
This gallery brings together photographs from workshops, project meetings, a study visit and conferences within BLUECONNECT — Enhancing Cross-Border Blue Growth: Fostering Innovation and Cooperation for Competitive Entrepreneurship.

These activities connect project partners and stakeholders across Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro, creating opportunities to exchange knowledge, explore practical solutions and build partnerships for a sustainable blue economy. They support cooperation around aquaculture, fisheries monitoring and resource-efficient fish processing, alongside the development of the Adriatic Blue Growth Cluster and its digital collaboration platform.

As Blue Growth Collaboration Platform Expert, contracted by the Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro, I support platform development, stakeholder engagement and cooperation arrangements. My ongoing work helps connect businesses, researchers and public authorities and establish a basis for collaboration beyond the project.
